newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU agrees import 10,000 T Canadian worked oats.
newsitem.headline: EU agrees import 10,000 T Canadian worked oats.

text.p: The European Union has agreed the import of 10,000 tonnes of Canadian worked oats at a reduced tariff, EU grain industry sources said on Friday.
The EU's grain committee took the decision at its weekly meeting on Thursday.
The move is part of a compensation package offered to Canada and the United States following the accession of three new EU member states in January.
Worked oats are a special type of oats destined for race horses and of which Canada is a major supplier.
